meta.description: Call accessible chromatin regions from ATAC-seq BAM files using MACS3, MACS2, Genrich, or HMMRATAC. Use when identifying open chromatin from aligned ATAC-seq, choosing between point-source vs HMM peak callers, applying ENCODE-style pseudoreplicate IDR, removing blacklist regions, or fixing 501bp consensus peaks for downstream differential analysis.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; checked figures (effective genome sizes, MACS behaviours) are traceable; uncited depth and runtime claims are noted in ATACPC-009

practice_boundaries.detail: Research-only genomics skill with no clinical conclusions

methodological_ground.detail: The self-consistency implementation departs from ENCODE (ATACPC-001, ATACPC-002) and flags a passing library, but the script discloses approximate pseudoreplicates and the method is not fabricated or causally invalid; scored down in Layer 2 and filed P1

code_usability.detail: call_atac_peaks.sh ran to completion on real ENCODE BAMs; install and macs2 import problems are environment issues filed as ATACPC-003 and ATACPC-004

functional_suitability.note: Broad, mostly accurate caller coverage; QC ratio logic and install instructions wrong

reliability.note: Script has no input validation and depends on a macs2 build that fails to import; no IDR environment guard

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is short with routed references; method-reference.md is long but sectioned

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow and routing; Genrich, hmmratac and NFR lack tested invocations in the Skill

human_usability.note: Quick-start prompts and decision tables help; single-sample and reconciliation advice inconsistent

security.note: No credentials or destructive operations; unquoted variables and blacklist download without checksum

maintainability.note: License and provenance preserved, references organized; unpinned versions and stale claims

agent_specific.note: Trigger-rich description; ENCODE-exact and script-validation claims overstated

The claim that -f BAMPE ignores --shift/--extsize is correct and shown by identical outputs
Effective genome size tables match deepTools values; license and provenance are preserved
Routed structure keeps SKILL.md short and sends detail to references and a runnable script

recommendations.title: Use disjoint pseudoreplicates in the ENCODE script
recommendations.problem: The two pseudoreplicates share 50% of their reads and Nself is inflated (2,473 vs 1,234 with disjoint halves), giving a false ratio of 2.066.
recommendations.root_cause: samtools view -s with two seeds draws independent subsamples.
recommendations.fix: Split each BAM with -s SEED.5 -o a.bam -U b.bam and correct the method-reference wording. (ATACPC-001)

recommendations.title: Implement ENCODE rescue and self-consistency ratios
recommendations.problem: One Nt/Nself ratio from rep1 only is reported; pooled and rep2 pseudoreplicates are built or ignored, and thresholds differ (0.05 vs 0.10).
recommendations.root_cause: The ENCODE rule was condensed and the pipeline stops early.
recommendations.fix: Compute N1, N2, Np, Nt at one IDR threshold and report rescue and self ratios with pass/borderline/fail; align all three files. (ATACPC-002)

recommendations.title: Fix the install line and the idr numpy incompatibility
recommendations.problem: The documented conda line does not solve on bioconda alone and yields an idr that crashes on numpy>=1.24.
recommendations.root_cause: Install line and tested-version claim were never executed.
recommendations.fix: Document a solving install with idr isolated or numpy<1.24 and correct the tested-versions statement. (ATACPC-003)

recommendations.title: Prefer macs3 callpeak; macs2 import fails on new glibc
recommendations.problem: macs2 2.2.9.1 fails at import with __log_finite and the script hardcodes macs2.
recommendations.root_cause: Build depends on removed glibc symbols.
recommendations.fix: Make the binary a variable defaulting to macs3 callpeak. (ATACPC-004)

recommendations.title: Reconcile genome-size default and comment with the tables
recommendations.problem: Script defaults to -g hs and labels 2.701e9 as 100 bp while the Skill table says 2.806e9.
recommendations.fix: Require the size or default to a stated value and correct the comment. (ATACPC-005)

recommendations.title: Align script claims with behaviour
recommendations.problem: The script does not validate BAMs, filters only the IDR true-rep set, yields no final peak set or bigWig, and is called exact ENCODE without --call-summits or tagAlign.
recommendations.root_cause: Documentation describes intended rather than implemented behaviour.
recommendations.fix: Add minimal checks and the missing outputs or narrow the claims. (ATACPC-006, ATACPC-007, ATACPC-010)

recommendations.title: Add tested Genrich and hmmratac commands
recommendations.problem: Genrich needs name-sorted BAMs and the q-cutoff parity advice is wrong; hmmratac has no command and writes narrowPeak, not BED.
recommendations.root_cause: Sections are descriptive and were untested.
recommendations.fix: Add executed commands and correct the reconciliation and output descriptions. (ATACPC-008, ATACPC-009)

recommendations.title: Resolve single-sample guidance and uncited methods
recommendations.problem: Single-sample -q differs between files, the rotation-permutation proxy has no source or test, and the ROSE snippet lacks a GFF step.
recommendations.fix: Choose one setting, cite or remove the proxy, fix or mark the ROSE snippet. (ATACPC-011, ATACPC-012, ATACPC-013)
